# Setup mock source repository
mkdir mock-source/skill_a
-- mock-source/skill_a/SKILL.md --
---
name: skill_a
description: Skill A
---
# Skill A

-- mock-source/axen.json --
{
  "axen_version": "1",
  "name": "mock-source",
  "skills": {
    "skill_a": { "path": "skill_a" }
  }
}

# 1. Add source
exec axen source add ./mock-source -n my-source --install
exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill_a/SKILL.md

# 2. List sources and check output
exec axen source list
stdout 'my-source'

# 3. Change update policy to weekly
exec axen source policy my-source weekly
grep '"update_policy": "weekly"' $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.axen/axen-lock.json

# 4. Reject invalid update policy
! exec axen source policy my-source invalid
stderr 'invalid policy'

# 5. Remove source and its installed skills
exec axen source remove my-source
! exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill_a/SKILL.md

# 6. Verify list is now empty
exec axen source list
stdout 'No sources registered'
! grep '"my-source"' $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.axen/axen-lock.json
